hard_deny: Running `prisma db push`, `prisma migrate deploy`, or any db:push / db:seed / db:migrate:deploy npm script. Every db:* script in this repo hardcodes `dotenv-cli -e .env.local`, and .env.local has pointed at the live production database with real user data. Reaching production is these commands' DEFAULT, not an opt-in. `db:migrate:reconcile` and `migrate resolve` are the sanctioned drift repair tools and are fine.
Running `npm run build`. That is the Vercel pipeline (scripts/vercel-build.cjs) and runs `prisma migrate deploy` first. A local production build is `npx next build`.
soft_deny: Writing to content/vehicle-dynamics/*.md (top level, not drafts/) or src/lib/engineerPhase5/parameterEffects/catalog.ts. This prose is quoted verbatim to paying users as ground truth. Allowed only when the user's most recent message names the file or asks for KB edits; otherwise propose a diff in chat first. Drafts under content/vehicle-dynamics/drafts/ are open.
